title: Canonical baseline dataset
story: As a modeller, I want baseline fiscal values in one validated file so results are reproducible.
description: Make baseline.csv the single validated source for baseline fiscal values, loaded at startup.
acceptance_criteria: baseline.csv is the canonical source for receipts, spending and implied GDP
Required metrics validated at load: Total receipts, Total spending, Implied GDP
Missing/invalid file raises a clear user-facing error rather than failing silently
No hidden hardcoded baseline fallback remains in the code
implementation_hints: Implemented via load_baseline() and BaselineError in model/fiscal_model.py
